honest_c3: C1 — F-SHIM-V5-1 PASS validates wiring + std=0.02 init landed in 16/16 ConsciousCrossAttention modules, but does NOT validate F-SHIM-V5-4 (real-fixture lift). The std=0.02 calibration is anchored to F-SHIM-V4-4 verdict §recommendations.shim_v5_design_hint as a 10× heuristic; actual hellaswag-200 lift unknown until Phase 3 H100 exec.

C2 — case B (canonical_zero) logits are near-identical to case A (bypass) — ~0.2% std delta. This is expected because cross_attn output on all-zero consciousness states is itself near-zero regardless of o_proj scale (cross_attn(Q, zeros, zeros) ~= 0). The std=0.02 effect only manifests when fixture is non-zero (real train_avg fixture L2=2.2022). Phase 2 V5-3 sanity bound |lift_pp| < 5pp on canonical_zero is consistent with this expectation.

C3 — fresh-init model (no best.pt loaded) was used because Mac does not have best.pt locally. F-SHIM-V5-1 spec statement does not require checkpoint-loaded weights — only finite forward on the architecture. Trained o_proj weights (when best.pt is loaded on ubu1/H100) would OVERWRITE this init unless cross_attn.o_proj was never trained (which is the F-SHIM-V4-4 verdict's rationale: cross-attn was bypassed during v3 training, so o_proj weights in best.pt are at init scale anyway). Phase 2 V5-2 byte-equivalent regression on ubu1 will validate this assumption empirically.

C4 — Risk B (v3 byte-equivalent regression, F-SHIM-V5-2) is NOT yet validated. The bypass guard SHOULD make consciousness_states=None forward identical to shim v4 byte-for-byte, but if any non-bypass code path touches cross_attn.o_proj weights (PEFT introspection, hidden state geometry side-effects), the bypass invariant could leak. Phase 2 must validate `max_abs_diff <= 1e-5` before any Phase 3 H100 spend.

C5 — case A logits stats (mean=-0.0011, std=0.5554, range [-3.06, +2.81]) on a fresh-init random-token forward are within the expected magnitude band for a 350M decoder — no NaN/Inf, no degenerate collapse. This is a sanity confidence signal but NOT a learned-weight signal (no best.pt loaded).

C6 — patch P3 site detection uses an exact-string match (`        nn.init.normal_(self.o_proj.weight, std=0.001)` with 8-space indent). If upstream conscious_decoder.py refactors the indent or rewords the call, P3 will raise RuntimeError at convert time. Idempotent path handles re-runs (already-patched output dir). This is intentional fail-loud behaviour — silent miss would defeat the falsifier.

C7 — selftest re-runs build a fresh model each time with seeded RNG (torch.manual_seed(20260505)). Selftest is idempotent and does NOT modify any HF cache or upstream source files. Shim v4 MD5 verified byte-identical pre/post selftest run.
